title: Handcannon
description: Adds the Arquebus item into the game.
body:
My first ever Minecraft mod which adds two new items into the game, the Arquebus and Bullet.
This mod is primarily made as an experiment/for personal use.

The Arquebus is a powerful alternative for the Bow and Crossbow, it has significantly less uses at just 32, but is capable of killing mobs with a single shot. It is also inaccurate at long distances. Recipes are unlocked after acquiring gunpowder.

Localised languages:
English
Finnish

Mod namespace: "handcannon"

Known issues:
Bullets that are fired from a Dispenser use arrow sounds.
